newsitem.title: USA: Andersen World board recommends Shaheen for chief.
newsitem.headline: Andersen World board recommends Shaheen for chief.

text.p: Andersen Worldwide said Monday that its Board of Partners has recommended George Shaheen, Managing Partner of Andersen Consulting, as the candidate for Managing Partner-Chief Executive of Andersen Worldwide.

Andersen Worldwide, is a professional services organization, consisting of Arthur Andersen, which provides accounting, tax, legal, business advisory and specialty consulting services, and Andersen Consulting, which provides management and technology consulting services.

The company said that in a previous ballot, Jim Wadia, UK Managing Partner of Arthur Andersen, received a majority of votes cast by Andersen Worldwide's partners but did not receive the two-thirds supermajority that is necessary to elect a candidate who has been recommended by the board.
